description: This file defines an interface class `IEventHandler` with four pure virtual methods for handling container events within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface class that specifies callback methods for container event handling such as start, stop, failure, and state change events.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container starts, receives JSON data object.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops, receives JSON data object.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container fails, receives JSON data object.

methods.name: onContainerStateChange
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container changes state, receives JSON data object.
